armyRule.name: Assigned Agents
armyRule.rule: Throughout the Imperium there exist numerous martial organisations and shadowy institutions. Bodies of armed warriors or solitary agents from these groups possess specialist skills, unusual equipment and vested interests that lead them to be attached to larger Imperial armies. Some are requisitioned by the army’s commander for their particular abilities, others are assigned by their hidden masters to achieve singular agendas. The most powerful have the authority and reputation to enforce their presence on the field of battle.

detachmentRule.name: Deathwatch Mission Tactics
detachmentRule.rule: Thousands of years of collated strategic data and hard-won combat experience have provided the Deathwatch with the ultimate battlefield tactics to combat almost any foe. Furor Tactics The warriors of the Deathwatch are often sorely outnumbered by swarming foes, yet by striking for maximum indiscriminate carnage they soon even the odds. While this Mission Tactic is active, weapons equipped by DEATHWATCH units from your army have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability. Malleus Tactics Even the largest behemoth has a weak point, and the Deathwatch find them all. While this Mission Tactic is active, weapons equipped by DEATHWATCH units from your army have the [LETHAL HITS] ability. Purgatus Tactics Adopting Purgatus tactics, the Deathwatch focus their ire upon the commanders of the enemy host. While this Mission Tactic is active, each time a DEATHWATCH model from your army makes an attack, on a Critical Wound , that attack has the [PRECISION] ability.

enhancements.name: Amulet of Auto-Chastisement
enhancements.description: This talisman houses a hate-filled machine spirit that despises alien artifice. Its influence can be focused against the war engines of aliens and traitors alike to disrupt or even paralyse them altogether. WATCH MASTER model only. At the start of your opponents Shooting phase , select one enemy VEHICLE unit (excluding TITANIC units) within 12" of and visible to the bearer. That unit must take a Leadership test . If that test is passed, until the end of the phase, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, subtract 1 from the Hit roll ; if that test is failed, that unit is not eligible to shoot this phase.

enhancements.name: Beacon Angelis
enhancements.description: The Beacon Angelis was devised to guide the Death watch to the threshold of the alien adversary. Housed within a reliquary, it calls out to the warriors’ augur arrays with the voices of a hundred electric cherubim, its summons so strong that it draws the righteous unto its locale regardless of what darkness may surround it. WATCH MASTER model only. Models in the bearer’s unit have the Deep Strike ability. In addition, you can target the bearer’s unit with the Rapid Ingress Stratagem for 0CP.

enhancements.name: Blackweave Shroud
enhancements.description: This hypermorphic bodyglove of uncertain origin is worn beneath a warrior’s armour. It forms a fibrous medium that shields the warrior’s most vital systems. AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM model only. The bearer has the Feel No Pain 4+ ability.

enhancements.name: Universal Anathema
enhancements.description: A fragment of STC technology, this device tastes the spoor of its owner’s foes, then fashions tailored toxins not even the most resilient victim can long endure. AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM model only. Melee weapons equipped by the bearer have the [ANTI-INFANTRy 2+] and [ANTI-MONSTER 4+] abilities.

stratagems.name: ARMOUR OF CONTEMPT
stratagems.description: The belligerence and transhuman physiologies of the Deathwatch make them unyielding foes.
stratagems.WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase , just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.TARGET: One DEATHWATCH unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.EFFECT: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

stratagems.name: ADAPTIVE TACTICS
stratagems.description: Only a truly versatile approach to warfare allows the Deathwatch to focus their tactical genius and best the myriad xenos foes they face.
stratagems.WHEN: Your Command phase .
stratagems.TARGET: One DEATHWATCH unit from your army.
stratagems.EFFECT: Select the Furor Tactics , Malleus Tactics or Purgatus Tactics . Until the start of your next Command phase, that Deathwatch Mission Tactic is active for your unit instead of any other Deathwatch Mission Tactic that is active for your army, even if you have already selected that Deathwatch Mission Tactic this battle.

stratagems.name: HELLFIRE ROUNDS
stratagems.description: Hellfire rounds contain reservoirs of virulent bioacids that eat away the flesh of their victims in seconds and leave nothing but bubbling gruel.
stratagems.WHEN: Your Shooting phase .
stratagems.TARGET: One DEATHWATCH INFANTRY unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons (excluding Devastating Wounds weapons ) equipped by models in your unit have the [ANTI-INFANTRY 2+] and [ANTI-MONSTER 5+] abilities.
stratagems.RESTRICTIONS: You cannot select any units that have already been targeted with either the Kraken Rounds or Dragonfire Rounds Stratagems this phase.

stratagems.name: DRAGONFIRE ROUNDS
stratagems.description: Dragonf ire rounds explode just before contact, saturating foes in cover with searing gas and flames.
stratagems.WHEN: Your Shooting phase .
stratagems.TARGET: One DEATHWATCH INFANTRY unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [ASSAULT] and [IGNORES COVER] abilities.
stratagems.RESTRICTIONS: You cannot select any units that have already been targeted with either the Kraken Rounds or Hellfire Rounds Stratagems this phase.

stratagems.name: KRAKEN ROUNDS
stratagems.description: Kraken rounds utilise adamantine cores and improved propellants to penetrate the thickest hide.
stratagems.WHEN: Your Shooting phase .
stratagems.TARGET: One DEATHWATCH INFANTRY unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit by 1 and improve the Range characteristic of those weapons by 6".
stratagems.RESTRICTIONS: You cannot select any units that have already been targeted with either the Dragonfire Rounds or Hellfire Rounds Stratagems this phase.

stratagems.name: RAPID TACTICAL RELOCATION
stratagems.description: The Ordo Xenos and Deathwatch alike have access to swift gunships and landers that allow for hasty repositioning in the midst of battle.
stratagems.WHEN: End of your opponent’s Fight phase .
stratagems.TARGET: One INQUISITOR or DEATHWATCH INFANTRY unit from your army.
stratagems.EFFECT: Remove your unit from the battlefield. In the Reinforcements step of your next Movement phase , set your unit up anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 9” horizontally away from all enemy models.
stratagems.RESTRICTIONS: You cannot select a unit that is within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.

detachmentRule.name: Root out Heresy
detachmentRule.rule: No matter how cunningly their heretical prey hides, they cannot escape the zealous retribution of the Ordo Hereticus.

enhancements.name: Ignis Judicium
enhancements.description: An artificer-crafted flame projector of focused and terrible vehemence, this weapon has been the bane of countless heretics across the ages. INQUISITOR or MINISTORUM PRIEST model only. The bearers ranged weapons have the [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] , [MELTA 1] and [PRECISION] abilities.

enhancements.name: Liber Heresius
enhancements.description: This ancient grimoire contains the collected accounts of many Inquisitorial purges, and is a trove of lore for those seeking to ambush and entrap heretics. INQUISITOR or MINISTORUM PRIEST model only. After both players have deployed their armies, select up to three AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM units from your army and redeploy them. When doing so, you can set those units up in Strategic Reserves if you wish, regardless of how many units are already in Strategic Reserves.

enhancements.name: No Escape (Aura)
enhancements.description: None but the most diabolical or desperate stand any chance of slipping through this Inquisitor’s grasp. INQUISITOR model only. While an enemy unit is within 6" of the bearer, each time it is selected to Fall Back it must first take a Leadership test . If that test is failed, that unit must Remain Stationary this phase instead.

enhancements.name: Witch Hunter
enhancements.description: This merciless Imperial agent is monomaniacally focused upon hunting and slaying psykers. INQUISITOR or MINISTORUM PRIEST model only. While the bearer is leading a unit, each time a model in that unit makes an attack that targets a PSYKER unit, you can re-roll the Hit roll .

stratagems.name: STUN GRENADES
stratagems.description: Emitting blasts of light, sound and blinding smoke, these devices disorient the foe.
stratagems.WHEN: Start of any phase (excluding the Command phase ).
stratagems.TARGET: One ADEPTUS ARBITES , INQUISITORIAL AGENTS or ORDO HERETICUS GRENADES unit from your army that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
stratagems.EFFECT: Select one enemy unit (excluding MONSTERS or VEHICLES ) within 8" of and visible to your unit. That enemy unit must take a Battle-shock test and, until the end of the phase, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, subtract 1 from the Hit roll .

stratagems.name: DISPENSE JUSTICE
stratagems.description: Agents of the Ordo Hereticus are unmerciful in meting out what they see as the Emperor's justice.
stratagems.WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase .
stratagems.TARGET: One ADEPTUS ARBITES , INQUISITORIAL AGENTS or ORDO HERETICUS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [LETHAL HITS] ability.

stratagems.name: INVIOLATE JURISDICTION
stratagems.description: These warriors defend the sanctity of the Emperor's realm with unwavering determination, no matter the odds stacked against them.
stratagems.WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase , just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.TARGET: One ADEPTUS ARBITES , INQUISITORIAL AGENTS or ORDO HERETICUS INFANTRY unit from your army within range of an objective marker and that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 5+ ability.

stratagems.name: EXECUTION ORDER
stratagems.description: There can be no mercy for heretic leaders.
stratagems.WHEN: Your Command phase .
stratagems.TARGET: One ADEPTUS ARBITES , INQUISITORIAL AGENTS or ORDO HERETICUS INFANTRY unit from your army.
stratagems.EFFECT: Select one enemy CHARACTER unit on the battlefield. Until the start of your next Command phase, each time a model in your unit targets that CHARACTER unit, its weapons have the [PRECISION] ability.

stratagems.name: LINE OF FIRE
stratagems.description: These ruthless warriors will risk firing into their own ranks if it ensures the deaths of heretics.
stratagems.WHEN: Your Shooting phase .
stratagems.TARGET: One ADEPTUS ARBITES , INQUISITORIAL AGENTS or ORDO HERETICUS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit can target enemy units that are within Engagement Range of one or more friendly units with ranged weapons (excluding Blast weapons ), provided the target is within 12".

stratagems.name: EXACT PUNISHMENT
stratagems.description: Vengeance is swift and unforgiving for those who attack the servants of the Emperor.
stratagems.WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase , just after an AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM unit from your army is destroyed as the result of an enemy unit's attacks.
stratagems.TARGET: One ADEPTUS ARBITES , INQUISITORIAL AGENTS or ORDO HERETICUS unit from your army that was within 6" of the destroyed unit (you cannot target the destroyed unit with the Stratagem).
stratagems.EFFECT: After the attacking unit has shot, your unit can shoot as if it were your Shooting phase, but when resolving those attacks it can only target that enemy unit (and only if it is an eligible target).

detachmentRule.name: Destroy the Daemonic
detachmentRule.rule: Knowing the vital nature of their mission, the servants of the Ordo Malleus fight all the harder to lay their enemies low.

enhancements.name: Daemon Slayer
enhancements.description: Some whisper this weapon of banishment is in fact host to a hostile warp entity in its own right. INQUISITOR model only. Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the bearers melee weapons, and those weapons have the [ANTI-DAEMON 3+] ability.

enhancements.name: Formidable Resolve
enhancements.description: Inquisitors of the Ordo Malleus are amongst the hardiest and most bombastic of their kind. They must be to survive their duties. INQUISITOR model only. Improve the bearer’s Leadership and Wounds characteristics by 1. Once per battle, at the start of any phase, you can select one friendly Battle-shocked unit within 12" of the bearer. That unit is no longer Battle-shocked.

enhancements.name: Gift of the Prescient
enhancements.description: Guided by the scryings of their Prognosticars, the Grey Knights strike with deadly precision and timing. INQUISITOR model only. Once per battle, if the bearer is on the battlefield, you can use the Rapid Ingress Stratagem for 0CP. When doing so, you must target a GREY KNIGHTS TERMINATOR SQUAD unit from your army, and when using that Stratagem, that unit can be set up anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 3" away from all enemy units.

enhancements.name: Grimoire of True Names (Aura)
enhancements.description: To wield the true name of a daemon is to control its supernatural power, though whether in the name of banishment or to be unleashed as a weapon of terror falls to the discretion of the grimoire’s keeper. INQUISITOR model only. While an enemy unit is within 9" of the bearer, worsen the Leadership characteristic of models in that unit by 1. In addition, while an enemy DAEMON unit is within 9" of the bearer, each time a model in that DAEMON unit makes an attack, subtract 1 from the Hit roll and subtract 1 from the Wound roll .

stratagems.name: RITUAL OF WARDING
stratagems.description: Whether sanctifying the battlefield against heresy or binding sinister guardian entities to keep watch, this ritual extends its practitioner’s strategic influence.
stratagems.WHEN: Start of any Command phase .
stratagems.TARGET: One INQUISITOR , INQUISITORIAL AGENTS or ORDO MALLEUS unit from your army that is within range of an objective marker you control.
stratagems.EFFECT: That objective marker is said to be Warded and remains under your control, even if you have no models within range of it, until your opponent controls it at the start or end of any turn. While an objective marker is Warded and under your control, enemy DAEMON units cannot be set up on the battlefield within 6" of it.

stratagems.name: RITES OF EXORCISM
stratagems.description: With the correct words of abjuration and banishment, daemons can be driven out of realspace and back into the warp.
stratagems.WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase .
stratagems.TARGET: One INQUISITOR , INQUISITORIAL AGENTS or ORDO MALLEUS unit from your army.
stratagems.EFFECT: Select one enemy DAEMON unit within 12" and visible to your unit. That unit must take a Battle-shock test . If that test is failed, then until the end of the phase, each time a friendly AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM unit makes an attack that targets that DAEMON unit, that attack has the [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] ability.

stratagems.name: STEEL HEART
stratagems.description: The battle-brothers of the Grey Knights never flee from their daemonic foes, instead merely withdrawing momentarily before striking anew.
stratagems.WHEN: Your Movement phase , just after a GREY KNIGHTS TERMINATOR SQUAD unit from your army Falls Back .
stratagems.TARGET: That GREY KNIGHTS TERMINATOR SQUAD unit.
stratagems.EFFECT: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.

stratagems.name: TRUESILVER ARMOUR
stratagems.description: Grey Knights battle plate incorporates litanies of purity, strands of sanctified silver and other sacred wards, whose defences can be further empowered by ritual mantras.
stratagems.WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase orthe Fight phase , just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.TARGET: One GREY KNIGHTS TERMINATOR SQUAD unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.EFFECT: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

stratagems.name: HEXAGRAMMIC WARDS
stratagems.description: Ancient warding sigils inscribed in shimmering silver, these strange runic designs ward away the hostile energies of the warp.
stratagems.WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase , just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.TARGET: One ORDO MALLEUS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, all Psychic weapons equipped by models in the attacking unit have the [HAZARDOUS] ability.

stratagems.name: PSYBOLT AMMUNITION
stratagems.description: Specially consecrated and silver-tipped, these bolt shells channel the firer’s innate psychic fury and detonate spectacularly on impact.
stratagems.WHEN: Your Shooting phase .
stratagems.TARGET: One GREY KNIGHTS TERMINATOR SQUAD unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [LETHAL HITS] and [PSYCHIC] abilities.

detachmentRule.name: At all Costs
detachmentRule.rule: While the nature of the missions undertaken by Imperial agents is as varied as they are, the vital importance of these tasks rarely changes. The enemies they face are the most unholy. The prizes they seek are as priceless as they are nightmarishly dangerous. Thus, when such warriors of the Imperium identify a priority target for elimination or acquisition, no effort is too great nor price too high to see their aims achieved. Eliminate At All Costs Select one enemy unit on the battlefield. Until the start of your next Command phase , each time an AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM model from your army makes an attack that targets that enemy unit, add 1 to the Hit roll . Acquire At All Costs Select one objective marker on the battlefield. Until the start of your next Command phase , while an AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM unit from your army is within range of that objective marker, improve the Leadership and Objective Control characteristics of models in that unit by 1 and models in that unit have a 5+ invulnerable save .

enhancements.name: Clandestine Operation
enhancements.description: This war leader prefers to strike with subtlety and precision, working their forces into advanced positions before commencing hostilities. AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM model only. At the start of the Declare Battle Formations step, you can select up to three AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM INFANTRY units from your army (excluding GREY KNIGHTS TERMINATOR SQUAD units) - those units gain the Infiltrators ability.

enhancements.name: Combat Landers
enhancements.description: This commander has access to swift drop craft that can bear portions of their forces directly into the heart of the most ferocious battles. VOIDFARERS model only. At the start of the Declare Battle Formations step, you can select up to three VOIDFARERS units from your army - those units gain the Deep Strike ability.

enhancements.name: Digital Weapons
enhancements.description: These potent, short-ranged energy weapons are concealed in precious items of jewellery, the better to lethally surprise the foe. AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM model only. Each time the bearer is selected to fight, roll three D6: for each 4+, one enemy unit within Engagement Range of the bearer suffers 1 mortal wound . Mortal wounds inflicted by this Enhancement are allocated as if they had the [PRECISION] ability.

enhancements.name: Fleetmaster
enhancements.description: Be they a Rogue Trader or some agent of the Imperial Navy, this warrior draws upon a wealth of shrewd voidfarer strategies to aid them in battle. VOIDFARERS model only. Once per battle round , you can target the bearer’s unit with the Violent Acquisition , Masters of the Void or Close-quarters Barrage Stratagems for 0CP.

stratagems.name: VIOLENT ACQUISITION
stratagems.description: If a high-ranking Imperial agent locates something they wish to acquire, nothing will stop them from unleashing all the forces at their command to seize it.
stratagems.WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase .
stratagems.TARGET: One AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM unit from your army.
stratagems.EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets an enemy unit within range of an objective marker , that attack has the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] , [LANCE] and [IGNORES COVER] abilities.

stratagems.name: MASTERS OF THE VOID
stratagems.description: With command of the orbital engagement zone comes the ability to strike at the enemy from unexpected angles.
stratagems.WHEN: Your Movement phase .
stratagems.TARGET: One VOIDFARERS CHARACTER unit from your army.
stratagems.EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM unit from your army that is arriving from Strategic Reserves this turn can be set up within your opponent’s deployment zone (all other restrictions still apply).

stratagems.name: CLOSE-QUARTERS BARRAGE
stratagems.description: Soldiers trained in shipboard warfare and chamber-by-chamber clearance know how best to focus theirfirepower during close-range firefights.
stratagems.WHEN: Your Shooting phase .
stratagems.TARGET: One VOIDFARERS unit from your army.
stratagems.EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a ranged attack that targets a unit within 12", improve the Strength and Armour Penetration characteristics of that attack by 1.

stratagems.name: EMPEROR’S WILL
stratagems.description: Believing theyfightforthe safety of the Golden Throne motivates warriors to exceptional deeds.
stratagems.WHEN: Your Movement phase .
stratagems.TARGET: One AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM unit from your army.
stratagems.EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, your unit is eligible to shoot in a turn in which it Advanced or Fell Back .

stratagems.name: DISPLACER FIELD
stratagems.description: These rare protective fields perform microteleport displacements to remove their bearers from harm.
stratagems.WHEN: Your opponent's Shooting phase , just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.TARGET: One AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM CHARACTER unit from your army (excluding OFFICIO ASSASSINORUM units) that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit's attacks.
stratagems.EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have a 4+ invulnerable save and, after the attacking unit has resolved its attacks, unless your unit is within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, it can make a Normal move of up to 6" (when doing so, models in this unit move as if they have the Fly keyword).

stratagems.name: SELFLESS BODYGUARD
stratagems.description: Loyal Imperial warriors will martyr themselves gladly to protect high-ranking Imperial agents.
stratagems.WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase , just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.TARGET: One AGENTS OF THE IMPERIUM Attached unit that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack with the [PRECISION] ability is allocated to a CHARACTER model in your unit, if there are one or more Bodyguard models in your unit, roll one D6: on a 2+, that attack is allocated to a Bodyguard model of your choice in your unit instead.
